label: B1 + dense CTI retrieval (exact persisted store)

retrieval.note: Dense-only. No BM25 index is constructed or mixed. Missing store/model fails configuration; there is no silent BM25 fallback. Encoder load and embedding inference are NOT VERIFIED in this phase.

generator.note: PROPOSED_NOT_ENFORCED. The current Hisoka runtime requests temperature=0.7 and max_tokens=4096 and can serve template/static fallback paths; seed and top_p are not exposed. The proposed values above are not applied by the runtime and are not a measured decoding contract.

resources.network: provider endpoint required for generation; no public listener
resources.note: Identical proposed CPU/memory/concurrency budget for B1-B3. These JSON fields are not cgroup, container, or scheduler enforcement; dense embedding memory is not separately budgeted.

command_template.note: Nonexecuted metadata. This starts serving wiring only; it does not invoke a frozen model experiment, and the proposed decoding settings are not applied.

prerequisites: Exact store with index.faiss, documents.json, and a recorded hash.
Frozen generator endpoint/model/revision and price recorded.
Prompt template and host-fiction file hashed.
